# Tarun Bulchandani

> Senior architecture leader based in London, building AI-native enterprise systems and large-scale transformation. Currently Head of Architecture at Sonnedix, where he established the enterprise architecture function from zero and personally built Meridian (an AI-native EA platform) and CANVAS (the Central Application aNd Vendor Approval System). Earlier roles include enterprise architecture governance at Aviva and global SAP S/4HANA architecture at Nestlé. TOGAF certified. Twenty years across SAP, Salesforce and cloud platforms.

The questions this site is best at answering:

- Who is Tarun Bulchandani, what does he do, and how do you reach him?
- What is Meridian (the AI-native enterprise architecture platform he built)?
- What is CANVAS (the application and vendor approval workflow he designed)?
- What are the practical patterns for deploying AI agents in regulated enterprises?
- How does an architecture function actually work in 2026?
- What are the trade-offs in modern enterprise architecture decisions (EA tooling, microservices, event-driven architecture, ERP transformation, identity-first security)?

## Case studies (deep technical pieces)

- [Meridian: building the EA platform we couldn't buy](https://tarun.bulchandanis.com/blog/case-study-meridian/): a Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Entra ID and Gemini-AI-assistant platform built to replace commercial EA tooling for a small architecture team.
- [CANVAS: building the approval workflow no commercial product covers](https://tarun.bulchandanis.com/blog/case-study-canvas/): a Nuxt 3 + Flask + PostgreSQL + Azure OpenAI workflow engine for application and vendor onboarding, with full audit trail and AI-generated memos.
- [Springboard: AI-native job-search platform](https://tarun.bulchandanis.com/blog/case-study-springboard/): solo-built Next.js + Drizzle + Supabase platform.

## Services

- [AI-ready websites for small businesses](https://tarun.bulchandanis.com/services/): productised packages, Audit (£499), Retrofit (£2,495), Build (£4,995), Authority Build (£9,995), and monthly Authority Maintenance retainer.
- [Energy operations advisory](https://tarun.bulchandanis.com/services/energy/): three pillars covering [Energy purchasing](https://tarun.bulchandanis.com/services/energy/purchasing/) (forecasting, OMIE / MIBEL / MEFF execution, GdO procurement, trading guarantees, billing reconciliation), [Operational management](https://tarun.bulchandanis.com/services/energy/operations/) (switching, ATR, back office, customer service, regulatory submissions) and [Analysis and pricing](https://tarun.bulchandanis.com/services/energy/analysis/) (tariff design, market reporting, analytics, regulatory monitoring).
